mechanism.summary: Execute a prevalidated bounded numeric control-flow leaf, including guarded Math intrinsics and recursively guarded global numeric-leaf callees, without constructing a nested function VM.
mechanism.generality: Eligibility is derived only from immutable bytecode and live value guards: primitive numeric or boolean local state, read-only captured primitive/function cells, bounded branch targets, direct Math own-data members, and current ordinary function values that satisfy the same numeric-leaf proof. It does not inspect source paths, function names, benchmark identity, inputs, or iteration counts. Any object/property operation other than the guarded Math member, captured/global write, this or arguments use, closure allocation, eval, with, unsupported call, getter, Proxy, or guard failure takes the unchanged VM path before observable work.
semantic_risks: preserving JavaScript Number, NaN, signed-zero, comparison, and truthiness behavior across conditional branches
resolving current realm global functions and Math own-data members without bypassing a rebinding, accessor, Proxy, or non-numeric fallback
preserving ordinary call semantics by declining before any observable work when a recursive callee cannot use the same proof
bounding recursive numeric call-graph evaluation so recursive or mutually recursive graphs retain the existing VM execution

profile_evidence.source: macOS sample 2026-07-27 /tmp/qjs-profile-imaging-darkroom-direct.sfd0we/profile.sample; direct source-level replay of hash-verified Kraken imaging-darkroom
profile_evidence.shared_cost: The pixel loop repeatedly enters ProcessImageData, FastGain, FastBias, and FastLog2 through call_direct_leaf_function, constructing nested Vm and CallEnv state around numeric branches and Math.log/Math.pow operations.
